# Microsoft Advertising

Manage Microsoft Advertising accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and asynchronous reports through the documented v13 REST APIs.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/microsoft-advertising/.

## Actions

- **Activate Ad Groups**: Activate up to 1,000 ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign.
- **Activate Campaigns**: Activate 1 to 100 Microsoft Advertising campaigns.
- **Create Search Ad Groups**: Create up to 1,000 Search ad groups under a Microsoft Advertising campaign.
- **Create Search Campaigns**: Create up to 100 Search campaigns with unshared budgets in a Microsoft Advertising account.
- **Delete Ad Groups**: Permanently delete 1 to 1,000 ad groups from a Microsoft Advertising campaign.
- **Delete Campaigns**: Permanently delete 1 to 100 campaigns from a Microsoft Advertising account.
- **Generate Account Performance Report** (read-only): Submit an account-performance report without polling, or check an existing report_request_id once.
- **Get Current Advertising User** (read-only): Return the connected Microsoft Advertising user and their customer/account roles.
- **List Accessible Customers** (read-only): Return Microsoft Advertising customers accessible to the connected user, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name prefix.
- **List Ad Groups** (read-only): Return ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign.
- **List Advertiser Accounts** (read-only): Return advertiser accounts accessible under a customer, including lifecycle and pause state needed before campaign work.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): Return campaigns in a Microsoft Advertising account.
- **Update Ad Groups**: Partially update up to 1,000 ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign.
- **Update Campaigns**: Partially update up to 100 campaigns in a Microsoft Advertising account.
